prompt_text: Who is the founder of the United State?
response_text:
The United States was not founded by a single individual but by a group of leaders who came together to declare independence from Britain and establish a new nation. These “Founding Fathers” include:

| Key figure | Role in founding |
|------------|------------------|
| **George Washington** | Leader of the Continental Army, first President (1789–1797) |
| **Thomas Jefferson** | Principal author of the Declaration of Independence (1776) |
| **John Adams** | Diplomat, second President (1797–1801) |
| **Benjamin Franklin** | Diplomat, key political thinker |
| **James Madison** | “Father of the Constitution,” later fourth President |
| **Alexander Hamilton** | First Secretary of the Treasury, key in shaping the financial system |
| **John Jay** | First Chief Justice of the Supreme Court |

The Declaration of Independence was adopted on **July 4, 1776**, and the Constitution was ratified in **1788**, formally establishing the United States. So, while George Washington is often highlighted as the first President and a symbolic founder, the nation’s founding is a collective achievement of many leaders.
